name: Persistence via scheduled task
summary: Encoded PowerShell execution followed by a scheduled task that launches cmd.exe. Trainees hunt the PowerShell activity and the task it leads to.
objectives: Find the encoded PowerShell command, decode it, and identify its parent.
Find the scheduled task that was created (name, action, trigger) and who created it.
Tie the two steps together on a timeline.
notes: The task 'spawn' is set to run once at 06:00, so it normally won't fire before Cleanup removes it. If you run this before 06:00, change the time input argument in the builder.

steps.title: Encoded PowerShell command
hunt_notes: Start from powershell.exe process events on {{Host}} in this step's UTC window; decode the -e argument and look at the parent process.

steps.title: Scheduled task created with schtasks.exe
hunt_notes: schtasks.exe /Create /TN spawn: note the action ({{task_command}}) and the start time ({{time}}), then pivot to the parent process.
